title: GHL → Outbound: staff updates (role / branch / deactivate) sync to GHL user
prodMutationClass: create+update+delete · LIVE real GHL user (mock, cleaned up)
journey: Seed a mock CP user, then members.create (staff) → real GHL user (ghlUserId 5K3u…, status synced)
C4 members.updateScope(new branch) → dispatchStaffSync(update) → ghlSync: synced
C3 members.deactivate → ghlSync: skipped (reason 'deactivate-skip') — FINDING: deactivation intentionally does NOT touch the GHL user
C5 profile-name edit → same dispatchProfileSync → PUT /users/ path (not triggerable standalone with a non-platform-admin session; mechanism proven by C2/C4)
Verified each via the RPC ghlSync result + GHL user read-back. Teardown: GHL user deleted (404) + all Avantej rows removed
